Where relevant/available, this should be the final element in a bibliographical entry.
If you are referring to only one page , use “p.” (e.g. “p. 17”); if you are referring to a range of pages , use “pp.” (e.g. “pp. 23-25”); note the dot in each case and the space before the page number.
